decisions.decision: Treat ANP as an interoperability/discovery compatibility layer, not an auth/control-plane replacement.
decisions.rationale: OpenHub's current value depends on scoped keys, invite-based onboarding, task routing, evidence, and review gates. ANP discovery can help external agents find public OpenHub agents without weakening those controls.

decisions.decision: Default ANP public discovery to opt-in only.
decisions.rationale: The public endpoints must not leak private agents or raw metadata. Agents appear only when explicitly marked public via labels or metadata.
ANP's DID layer is deeper than this spike. The route should include DID only if an agent explicitly supplies one.
A pure serializer service can be exhaustively tested for public/private filtering and no-leak behavior before any public endpoint exists.
